text:
maya: quick summary — did a focused dial of max_batch_tokens and max_wait_ms across kernels to see p95/p99 vs throughput tradeoffs. data attached below.

maya: TL;DR: bumping max_batch_tokens from 4k->16k gave ~22% throughput uplift but p99 jumped on long-tail prompts when kv-hit < 80%. seems correlated with kernel fallback frequency and kv cache churn.

jon: nice. which kernels did you test?

maya: matmul_fused, attn_sparse, attn_dense. also toggled kernel fallback to force dense for small seqs.

priya: can you paste the sweep config?

maya: sure:
```
sweep: 
  kernels: [matmul_fused, attn_sparse, attn_dense]
  max_batch_tokens: [4096, 8192, 16384]
  max_wait_ms: [3, 8, 20]
  microbatch_target_tokens: [64, 128]
  kv_cache_policy: [aggressive, conservative]
```

luca: where are the perf numbers? p95/p99 + kv hit rates ideally.

maya: pasted a small excerpt from the perf summary (all numbers median across 30m):
```
config A: max_batch_tokens=4096 max_wait_ms=3 kv=aggressive
  throughput: 320 req/s
  p95: 110ms p99: 240ms
  kv_hit: 92% kernel_fallback_rate: 3%

config B: max_batch_tokens=16384 max_wait_ms=8 kv=aggressive
  throughput: 390 req/s (+22%)
  p95: 120ms p99: 520ms
  kv_hit: 77% kernel_fallback_rate: 11%
```

priya: wow p99 doubled. do you have traces for the p99 tails?

maya: yes — most p99 traces show frequent cache evictions and a bunch of long-running attn_dense kernels due to fallback. here's an anonymized trace snippet: 
```
TRACE_START
 -> route: kernel=matmul_fused seq=2048 tokens=512
 -> event: kv_miss for prefix_id=0 (cache_evicted)
 -> fallback to attn_dense kernel (est 3.8ms per step but no fused matmul)
 -> queue_wait: 18ms (batch accumulation)
 -> exec: attn_dense 220ms
TRACE_END
```

jon: that queue_wait 18ms is expected given higher max_batch_tokens, but 220ms exec is the killer. that suggests fallback dense kernels are slow at those seq lengths.

luca: did you try lowering max_wait_ms to keep tails down while keeping larger max_batch_tokens?

maya: yes — with max_batch_tokens=16384 but max_wait_ms=3 (so shorter waiting) we got throughput 360 req/s, p99 280ms, kv_hit 79%. better p99 than wait_ms=8 but throughput dropped.

priya: sounds like a sweet spot tradeoff: allow big batches but cap wait. any impact on small-req latency (p50)?

maya: p50 stable across configs (~22ms). tail mainly affects p99.

luca: could we mitigate kernel fallback by preemptively routing longer seqs to attn_sparse or reserving a fast-path pool with pinned kernels?

maya: tried static routing by seq_len>1024 -> attn_sparse. reduced fallback_rate to ~4% and p99 improved to ~200ms for the 16k batch case, throughput ~370 req/s. drawback: attn_sparse uses more memory so fewer concurrent batches -> small throughput loss vs forced dense fallback.

jon: what about kv cache policies? aggressive seems to increase hits but also evictions due to larger batches?

maya: exactly. aggressive keeps more recent prefixes, but larger batch sizes cause cache churn earlier. conservative policy keeps fewer entries but lower eviction thrash on high concurrency. empirical: for 16k batches, conservative kv_cut reduced cache evictions by 30% and p99 by ~80ms but lowered kv_hit from 77%->70% which slightly hurt avg throughput.

priya: we should run a micro-experiment: keep max_batch_tokens=8192, max_wait_ms=5, route seq>1024 to attn_sparse pool, kv_policy=conservative. measure for 1 hour and capture p99 traces.

maya: queued that: infra-bot scheduled the job.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: job_id=rt-sweep-2026-11-02-09, workers=12, expected runtime ~60m. link: https://ci.internal/jobs/rt-sweep-2026-11-02-09

jon: thanks. also can we add kernel-level perf counters in next run to capture fused vs dense time per-layer? will help quantify fallback cost.

maya: yes adding layer_timing and kv_eviction_reason to tracing.

luca: plan for rollout: default max_batch_tokens=8192, max_wait_ms=5, route heuristics enabled; enable adaptive kv_policy toggle if kv_hit drops below 75% to switch to conservative. roll this to canary group first.

priya: agree. we should also add an alert: if p99 increases >2x for 30m during canary, auto-revert.

maya: noted. I'll add the config to the rollout PR and attach perf graphs.

jon: awesome work, thanks maya :thumbsup:

maya: will post final artifacts once the canary run finishes.
